access: Stearns and Hunt introduced SH. For the normalized length convention, see the introduction and footnotes 1–2 in arXiv:2611.02650v2, pp. 1–2.
conventions: Whole fixed-power exclusion family. Conversions to variable count, clause count or combinatorial length require the stated normalization or sparsification argument.
definition: The deterministic decision power index of CNF-SAT is one.
model: Explicit CNF-SAT with the source encoding length as the size measure.
name: Satisfiability Hypothesis
quantifiers: For each fixed 0 < a < 1 there is no deterministic 2^O(n^a) · poly(n) SAT algorithm, with n the normalized input length.

source.locator: Definition 2.1, p. 210, and Satisfiability Hypothesis, §2, p. 213
